**Requires Python.** This demo reads and writes Word, PDF, Excel, and PowerPoint
files — formats Claude Code doesn't parse natively — so it installs and calls
Python libraries (`python-docx`, `python-pptx`, `openpyxl`) behind the scenes.
Make sure Python and `pip` are available on the machine before running the
`/collect` → `/synthesize` → `/report` pipeline.
